ASSAM SCHEDULE VIII FORM NO. 127 
HIGH COURT CRIMINAL FORM (M) 166 
IN THE COURT OF THE CHIEF JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE, SEPPA, EAST KAMENG 
ARUNACHAL PRADESH 
 
Domestic Violence C/ No. 03/2025 and Misc. case No. 53/2025 
    Smti Yadang Nampe     ……..Petitioner 
-Vs-  
          Samba Nampe            ………Respondent 
 
 
  
Date 
Order 
Signature 
16.01.2026 
Aggrieved person namely Smti Yadang Nampe 
and her learned counsels Ms Yanum Singhi and 6(six) 
other advocate are absent, 
however, Mr 
Debo 
Mangkhya, 
proxy 
counsel 
is 
present 
seeking 
adjournment of the case.  
Respondent Samba Nampe is present along with 
his learned counsel Mr Bida Sonam who filed 
vakalatnama for himself, Mr Sunil Tara and Mr Atum 
Lamnio vide F/No. 02/2026 dated 16.01.2026. 
Heard Mr Bida Sonam who submitted that the 
respondent has already received the service copy of 
both DV case as well as Misc. case and prayed for 
giving the respondent an opportunity to file written 
reply of the case.  
The prayer is allowed.  
 
List up the case on 17/02/2026 for filing written 
reply. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
(Damge Niri) 
CJM, Seppa
